name: New York City Board of Elections

feed.identity_note: Answered our named User-Agent on Nov 3, 10:19 to 10:23 PM CT (src-east builder): 200s from Cloudflare, Last-Modified on every page, no challenge.
feed.election_id_from:
index.html's own heading, "SPECIAL
NOVEMBER 3, 2026", above "UNOFFICIAL ELECTION NIGHT RESULTS" (the board's wording; the ballot is the Nov 3 general). The site has no election id.
feed.pages_note: Each office's Expand List page (every district on one page) plus the single-contest pages for the City Council special and Proposals 1 to 5. Governor, Comptroller and Attorney General (OF4, OF52, OF53) are left out: statewide items come only from a state source, and New York State's own site refuses scripts.
